review.assessment: This diff adds `src/lib.rs` containing a naive nested-loop implementation of `has_duplicate_within_k`. While it passes the provided unit test and correctly handles array bounds, it completely ignores the optimization mandate to run in roughly linear time. The algorithmic complexity remains O(N²) (or O(N×k)), failing the core task requirement.

findings.actual: Execution time scales quadratically relative to input size and window k; grinds to a halt on large arrays due to redundant pairwise scanning.
findings.expected: Execution time scales linearly with array length; completes instantly for typical limits.
